stories.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
stories.body: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

stories.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
stories.body: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

stories.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
stories.body: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

stories.title: Trump says Musk has restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network
stories.body: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.

stories.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
stories.body: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.

stories.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
stories.body: A Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia - one of several such cases in Germany this year.

stories.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
stories.body: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

stories.title: Lula says rival should be disqualified over alleged Meta interference ahead of Brazil vote
stories.body: The Brazilian president accuses the tech firm of favouring Flávio Bolsonaro, which it denies.

stories.title: Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots
stories.body: Protests will only be allowed in some towns and cities if organised by unions, and top museums will be closed on Saturday.

stories.title: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
stories.body: The teacher said she could not help children because she was badly injured by the attacker.

stories.title: 'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
stories.body: Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy is airing the ad featuring her mother, whose husband was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.

stories.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
stories.body: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.

stories.title: 'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular pleads not guilty to rape charge
stories.body: The influencer, whose real name is Braden Peters, is accused of sexually assaulting a 17-year-old girl in 2025.

stories.title: Police investigate Married at First Sight Australia after 'inappropriate' allegations
stories.body: New South Wales Police say inquiries took place "following a report of inappropriate content being shared".

stories.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
stories.body: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom.

stories.title: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
stories.body: The congresswoman said federal agents seized over a dozen items, including cell phones and notebooks, as part of a federal investigation.

stories.title: YouTuber arrested after popular Indian finance influencer's suicide
stories.body: V Harish, who ran the hugely popular Instagram account "Finance with Harish", was found dead on Tuesday.

stories.title: Celebrity shark guided out of South Korea canal refuses to swim out to sea
stories.body: Bukangi the shark became an unlikely sensation after it was spotted in a canal in Busan weeks ago.

stories.title: El Salvador's president threatens Haitian gangs over military hostages
stories.body: Four members of the so-called Gang Suppression Force have been missing since Sunday.

stories.title: First human case of Shamonda virus detected in France, officials say
stories.body: The disease, which usually affects cattle, has been identified in a patient who died in early October.
